statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary for this patient
